title: Director of Practice Operations
text:
Come work at the best place to give and receive care!

**Job Description:**

**Who We Are:** 
Southern New Hampshire Health has been a cornerstone of the region since 1893, delivering high-quality, compassionate care close to home. We are One Extraordinary Team, Centered on Patients, In Pursuit of Excellence, and Rooted in Kindness. These values shape how we care for our patients, collaborate with colleagues, and continuously improve the health and well-being of the communities we serve. Anchored by Southern New Hampshire Medical Center—a 188-bed, DNV-accredited hospital in downtown Nashua with a Level III-N trauma center, Level II Special Care Nursery, and Magnet® designation for nursing excellence—we offer a full spectrum of services from primary care to advanced diagnostics and specialized treatments. Our medical staff includes over 500 providers from Foundation Medical Partners, and local practices. Foundation Medical Partners, our multi-specialty group, spans 70+ practices across southern New Hampshire and northern Massachusetts, providing coordinated, patient-centered care to thousands each year.

**About the Job:** 
As the Director of Operations for Foundation Medical Partners (FMP), you will play a key leadership role in shaping patient care delivery, driving operational effectiveness, and supporting strategic initiatives across our practices. In addition to guiding daily practice operations and performance improvement, you will oversee the operational success of our clinical education programs—serving as a vital bridge between providers, practice staff, students, and system leadership.

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Drive Operational Excellence:** Partner with FMP and Southern New Hampshire Health System (SNHHS) leadership to develop and execute strategic plans, policies, and operational improvement initiatives while ensuring effective resource utilization.
* **Lead Clinical Education Programs:** Oversee all operational aspects of the UNE COM Medical Student program—mentoring fourth-year students through scheduling and residency planning—and manage the onboarding and coordination of NP, PA, tech, and shadowing students across SNHHS.
* **Champion Team & Provider Success:** Lead new staff orientation, support recruitment, and act as a coach, mentor, and primary communicator to foster collaboration between providers and administrative teams.
* **Ensure Regulatory Compliance:** Maintain strict adherence to FMP policies, accreditation standards, and state and federal regulations, including HIPAA.

**Who You Are:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree required (or an additional 4 years of relevant management experience in lieu of a degree).
* **Experience:** Minimum of 5 years of management experience encompassing operations, project management/implementation, finance, regulatory compliance, organizational behavior, or reporting.
* **Preferred Knowledge:** Background in statistics and data collection.
* **Skills & Abilities:** A collaborative leader with strong fiscal and operational acumen, advanced computer proficiency, and the ability to build high-performing teams and earn trust across a complex clinical environment.

**Why You’ll Love Us:**

* Health, dental, prescription, and vision coverage for full-time & part-time employees
* Short-term, long-term disability, life & pet insurance
* Tuition reimbursement & Nursing Student Loan Paydown Program
* 403(b) Retirement savings plans
* Continuous earned time accrual & more!

**Work Shift:**

8-5

*SolutionHealth is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*
